title: Does John 17:3 Deny That Jesus Is God?
primary_keyword: does John 17:3 deny that Jesus is God
secondary_keywords: Jesus calls the Father the only true God
topic_cluster: Christology, Trinity and the divine identity of Jesus
search_intent: A Christian, Muslim friend, Unitarian reader or sceptic wants to know whether John 17:3 excludes Jesus from deity.
primary_search_query: does John 17:3 deny that Jesus is God
answer_system_quote_target: John 17:3 does not deny that Jesus is God. Jesus names the Father as the only true God while also placing Himself beside the Father as the source of eternal life and claiming the glory He shared with Him before creation. John presents Father and Son as distinct persons within the one divine being.
likely_follow_up_questions: Why does Jesus call the Father the only true God?
Is Jesus distinct from the Father?
How does John present Jesus as God?
app_conversion_path: Invite Christians to practise reading John 17:3 with John 17:5 and answering with both doctrinal clarity and gentleness.
cluster_role: Deepens the existing Christology cluster by answering a specific proof-text objection that sits between the Trinity, Son of God and divine-claims pages.
